name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs attention across the residences, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Code and house checks
sections.note: Each line cites its rule in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, subject, issue from compliance_issues order by rule, subject

sections.title: Welfare due
sections.sql: select resident, item, due_on, coalesce(owner, '') as owner from welfare_due order by due_on

sections.title: Arriving in the next three weeks
sections.sql: select resident, building, room, term, starts_on, status from arrivals order by starts_on

sections.title: Leaving in the next three weeks
sections.sql: select resident, building, room, ends_on from departures order by ends_on

sections.title: Fees overdue
sections.sql: select resident, term, balance_cents, days_overdue, (select value from settings where key = 'currency') as currency from arrears order by days_overdue desc

name: occupancy
title: Occupancy
subtitle: Beds, residents and vacancies by building

sections.title: By building
sections.sql: select building, beds, offline, occupied, vacant, occupancy_pct from occupancy order by building

sections.title: Rooms with a free bed today
sections.sql: select b.name as building, rm.name as room, rm.room_type as type, rm.beds - (select count(*) from live_contracts lc where lc.room_id = rm.id)::int as free_beds from rooms rm join buildings b on b.id = rm.building_id where rm.offline_reason is null and rm.beds > (select count(*) from live_contracts lc where lc.room_id = rm.id) order by b.name, rm.name

sections.title: Rooms offline
sections.sql: select b.name as building, rm.name as room, rm.offline_reason as reason from rooms rm join buildings b on b.id = rm.building_id where rm.offline_reason is not null order by b.name, rm.name

name: welfare
title: Welfare board
subtitle: Open concerns, plans and who has not been seen. Staff only.

sections.title: Open concerns
sections.sql: select r.name as resident, c.reported_on, c.category, c.risk, c.summary from concerns c join residents r on r.id = c.resident_id where c.closed_on is null order by c.risk = 'high' desc, c.reported_on

sections.title: Open welfare plans
sections.sql: select r.name as resident, p.owner, p.review_on, p.summary from welfare_plans p join residents r on r.id = p.resident_id where p.closed_on is null order by p.review_on

sections.title: Days since last check
sections.sql: select resident, building, room, last_check, days_since_check from residents_now order by days_since_check desc
